meta.title: KNOWLEDGE X — System Architecture
meta.subtitle: Streamlit AI Research Workspace · In-Process Python Modules, SQLite Storage & Google Cloud Integrations

views.label: Full System
views.note: Primary research ingestion, structured AI synthesis, exploration UI, and storage.

views.label: Auth & Security
views.note: Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE + OIDC verification, signed cookies, per-user storage, and URL SSRF defense.

components.label: User Browser
components.explanation: Renders the dark-themed Streamlit UI, camera capture widget, and Plotly charts while persisting the signed kx_auth_session cookie via components.html.

components.label: App Shell
components.explanation: Bootstraps session_state, runs _handle_google_auth_lifecycle() on every rerun, draws the top-left sidebar avatar popover, multi-PDF uploader, and Gemini model selector.

components.label: 7 Pages
components.explanation: Seven specialized Streamlit views sharing st.session_state and delegating domain logic cleanly to backend Python modules.

components.label: OAuth Engine
components.explanation: Generates PKCE S256 challenges, verifies Google OIDC ID tokens via google-auth, mints 7-day SQLite-backed session cookies, and partitions per-user upload folders.

components.label: Ingestion & OCR
components.explanation: Extracts text/metadata with PyMuPDF, fetches public PDF URLs behind a 5-hop DNS/IP SSRF firewall (25MB cap), checks scan sharpness via NumPy Laplacian variance, and builds invisible-text searchable PDFs via Gemini Vision.

components.label: AI Engines
components.explanation: Produces cross-paper concept synthesis, Plotly coverage heatmaps, NetworkX knowledge graphs (AI semantic or PyMuPDF fallback), and 3-way query disambiguation with clarifying rewrites.

components.label: SQLite DB
components.explanation: Persists research_sessions and ambiguity_history scoped by user_id after secret sanitization, plus auth_sessions, oauth_states, and app_settings.

components.label: PDF Store
components.explanation: Stores raw, URL-fetched, and searchable OCR PDFs on disk inside legacy or SHA-256 user-isolated directories.

components.label: Gemini Gateway
components.explanation: Centralizes API key resolution, secret redaction, Pydantic response_schema enforcement, 90s timeout, retry_attempts=2, daily quota tracking, and automatic model fallback.

components.label: Google OAuth
components.explanation: External Google identity provider handling consent redirects, authorization code token exchange, and public JWKS ID-token verification.

components.label: PDF Hosts
components.explanation: Third-party academic or public PDF servers accessed only when DNS resolves strictly to public IP space and magic bytes match %PDF-.

components.label: Gemini API
components.explanation: Google Gemini models (default gemini-3.6-flash with automatic fallback chain) powering structured synthesis, QA, ambiguity JSON, and scanned-page OCR.

cards.title: Architecture Summary
items: Pure Python Streamlit 1.45+ monolith running in a single process with st.navigation(position='sidebar').
No separate REST API server or message queue: frontend pages invoke backend modules directly via typed dataclasses/Pydantic models.
Offline evaluation harness in evaluation/ (build_dataset.py, run_ambiguity_eval.py) benchmarks the ambiguity detector.

cards.title: Security & Isolation Controls
items: Google OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE S256, OIDC ID-token verification, and signed 7-day SQLite session cookies.
Every saved analysis/ambiguity record and upload directory is partitioned by authenticated user_id or legacy_local.
URL ingestion blocks private/loopback/link-local/reserved/NAT64 IPs across up to 5 HTTP redirects; secrets are scrubbed before storage.
